ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_RBC_ANTIGENS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_rbc_antigens(pl_donor_id in varchar2) IS

 Cursor rbc_cur is 
 select a.test_id, decode(a.result_code, 'P', '+', 'N', '-') 
 from donor_rbc_antigens a, valid_tests_don b
 where a.test_id = b.test_id 
 and a.donor_id = pl_donor_id 
 and b.antigen_flag = 'R' 
 order by a.test_id; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2011. SCR 17947
 --order by b.antigen_group; -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2011. SCR 17947
 
 v_test varchar2(10);
 v_result varchar2(10);
 v_item_pos number:=0;
 result_rec unit_test_results%rowtype;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN

 if rbc_cur%isopen then
 close rbc_cur;
 end if;
 
 go_block('rbc_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_block_property('rbc_block',insert_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('rbc_block',update_allowed,property_true);
 first_record;
 open rbc_cur;
 loop
 begin
 FETCH rbc_cur into v_test,v_result; 
 nCount:=nCount +1;
 if rbc_cur%notfound then
 exit;
 end if; 

 if v_result='+' then 
 display_item('RBC_BLOCK.test_id','blue_attr');
 display_item('RBC_BLOCK.result_code','blue_attr');
 else
 display_item('RBC_BLOCK.test_id','red_attr');
 display_item('RBC_BLOCK.result_code','red_attr');
 end if;

 :RBC_BLOCK.test_id:=v_test;
 :rbc_block.result_code:=v_result; 
 create_record;
 end;
 end loop;
 close rbc_cur;
 set_block_property('rbc_block',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('rbc_block',update_allowed,property_false);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MOVE_BLOCKS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE move_blocks IS

 v_hla_a1 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_a2 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_b1 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_b2 VARCHAR2(5);

 v_hla_c1 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_c2 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_d1 VARCHAR2(5);
 v_hla_d2 VARCHAR2(5);

 v_hla_dr VARCHAR2(5);


BEGIN


 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 populate_hla_antigens(:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id,v_hla_a1,v_hla_a2,v_hla_b1,v_hla_b2,
 v_hla_c1,v_hla_c2,v_hla_d1,v_hla_d2,v_hla_dr);

 :hla_block.s_hla_a1:=v_hla_a1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_a2:=v_hla_a2;

 :hla_block.s_hla_b1:=v_hla_b1; 
 :hla_block.s_hla_b2:=v_hla_b2; 

 :hla_block.s_hla_c1:=v_hla_c1;
 :hla_block.s_hla_c2:=v_hla_c2;

 :hla_block.s_hla_d1:=v_hla_d1; 
 :hla_block.s_hla_d2:=v_hla_d2; 
 
 :hla_block.s_hla_cr:=v_hla_dr; 

 go_block('rbc_block');
 populate_rbc_antigens(:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id);
 first_record;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_HLA_ANTIGENS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_hla_antigens(pl_donor_id in varchar2,pl_hla_a1 out varchar2,pl_hla_a2 out varchar2,
 pl_hla_b1 out varchar2,pl_hla_b2 out varchar2,
 pl_hla_c1 out varchar2,pl_hla_c2 out varchar2,
 pl_hla_d1 out varchar2,pl_hla_d2 out varchar2,
 pl_hla_dr out varchar2) IS

 cursor hla_cur is select * from donor_hla_antigens where donor_id=pl_donor_id;
 hla_rec donor_hla_antigens%rowtype;

BEGIN

if hla_cur%isopen then
 close hla_cur;
end if;

 open hla_cur;

 FETCH hla_cur into hla_rec;
 pl_hla_a1:=hla_rec.a1;
 pl_hla_a2:=hla_rec.a2;

 pl_hla_b1:=hla_rec.b1;
 pl_hla_b2:=hla_rec.b2; 

 pl_hla_c1:=hla_rec.c1;
 pl_hla_c2:=hla_rec.c2;

 pl_hla_d1:=hla_rec.d1;
 pl_hla_d2:=hla_rec.d2;
 
 pl_hla_dr:=hla_rec.dr;
 close hla_cur;
 set_block_property('hla_block',update_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('hla_block',insert_allowed,property_false);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2, pl_donor_id in varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PULL_UP_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pull_up_data IS
 v_blood_type varchar2(5);
 v_ssn number(10);
BEGIN

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 begin
 select b.blood_type,b.last_name||' , '||b.first_name||' '||b.middle_name donor_name,
 b.date_of_birth,b.gender into 
 v_blood_type,:hla_block.s_donor_name,:hla_block.s_dob,
 :hla_block.s_sex from donors b where 
 b.donor_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id;
 exception 
 when others then
 message('could not bring the donor information');
 check_package_failure;
 end;


 begin
 select description into :hla_block.s_abo_type from valid_master_codes where 
 code=v_blood_type and code_type='ABO';
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :hla_block.s_abo_type:='Unknown';
 end ;
 move_blocks;

 set_item_property('hla_block.pb_donor_interdictions',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('hla_block.s_dob',insert_allowed,property_false);
 go_block('hla_block');

EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;
